audioClockRules: Use decoded audio PTS as the sole final timeline clock.
Scale all provisional scene fractions to the exact probed audio duration before snapping.
Snap scene boundaries to the nearest TrackPrompt phrase or section boundary within 1.25 seconds.
Prefer a downbeat or strong onset when two candidates are equally close.
Preserve scene order, 16-scene count, and final audio duration.
Do not cut off the audio tail; hold or fade the final image to the exact last audio sample.
Transitions may overlap adjacent clips but must not change the total timeline duration.
